news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues miss analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹48.82 (up from ₹41.17 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹208.2b (up 25% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹19.5b (up 18% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 9.4% (in line with FY 2025). Revenue missed analyst estimates by 3.7%. Earnings per share (EPS) also missed analyst estimates by 8.9%. Revenue is forecast to grow 2.5% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Chemicals industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 24% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 16% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

Analyst Commentary Bullish Takeaways Bullish analysts view the unchanged fair value estimate of ₹559.50 per share as consistent with their thesis that Chambal Fertilisers and Chemicals has a reasonably clear earnings profile under the current set of revenue and margin assumptions.

news.title: CHAMBLFERT: Higher Future P E And Board Review Will Support Upside
news.body: Analysts have kept their fair value estimate for Chambal Fertilisers and Chemicals steady at ₹559.50. However, slightly lower revenue growth and profit margin assumptions have been offset by a higher future P/E multiple, so the updated target reflects a more valuation-driven view than before.

news.title: New major risk - Revenue and earnings growth
news.body: Earnings are forecast to decline by an average of 0.03% per year for the foreseeable future. This is considered a major risk. Ultimately, shareholders want to see a good return on their investment and that generally comes from sharing in the company's profits. If profits are expected to decline, then in most cases the share price will decline over time as well. In addition, if the company pays dividends it will also likely need to reduce or cut them, striking a dual blow to total shareholder returns. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Earnings are forecast to decline by an average of 0.03% per year for the foreseeable future. Minor Risk Paying a dividend despite having no free cash flows.

Analyst Commentary Recent commentary on consumer names has focused more on how investors are weighing growth visibility, brand positioning and valuation multiples rather than big changes in underlying earnings assumptions.

news.title: CHAMBLFERT: Upcoming Results And Recalibrated P E Multiple Will Support Upside
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their fair value estimate for Chambal Fertilisers and Chemicals slightly from ₹568 to about ₹559.5, reflecting updated assumptions for higher long term revenue growth, modestly stronger profit margins and a lower future P/E multiple. Analyst Commentary Analysts updating their models for Chambal Fertilisers and Chemicals are framing the trimmed fair value estimate as a fine tuning rather than a major reset, with attention on how growth assumptions, profitability and valuation multiples fit together.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues miss analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹14.64 (up from ₹13.34 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹59.0b (up 20% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹5.86b (up 9.7% from 3Q 2025). Earnings per share (EPS) also missed analyst estimates by 5.2%. Revenue is forecast to grow 3.8% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Chemicals industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 23% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 15% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
